Context: C. Other than exoneration/ minor penalty

- (c) If the Government servant so desires, the period of suspension may be converted into leave of the kind due and admissible. (Non: Such leave can be in excess of 3 months in case of temporary Government servants or 5 years in case of permanent Government servants). - FR 54-B (7).  
As per FR 54-B (9), wherever the amount allowed is less than full pay and allowances, it shall not be less than the Subsistence Allowance  
NOTE.already paid.
